roulette_rules.refuse: keeps all points and proceeds to final round without penalty
roulette_rules.neutral: no points gained or lost; no shield or protection state
roulette_rules.pedagio: each other participant transfers exactly 1 point to selected player; negative balances allowed
roulette_rules.imposto: selected player transfers exactly 1 point to each other participant; negative balances allowed
roulette_rules.swap: swaps full score values, including negative balances
roulette_rules.crown: offers only selected categories with a question reserved in the current match; uses a question from that category
roulette_rules.skip: selected player is excluded from the final round only

automated_tests.question_bank: 800 valid questions; 10 categories; 80 each; four alternatives; valid correct indices; unique IDs
automated_tests.roulette_logic: isolated tests passed for +5, -5, neutral, swap, toll with negative balances, tax with negative balances, and skip
automated_tests.question_selection: category coverage guaranteed when the number of rounds/questions permits; Crown options filtered to categories with a reserved question
